caption: The drawing features the silhouette of a rooster standing atop a horizontal rectangular base. The rooster is depicted in profile, facing left, with its beak slightly open and its comb and wattle visible. The tail is large, rounded, and has a scalloped edge. The rooster's body is rendered in a brownish-golden color with irregular darker patches, giving a mottled effect. The base is similarly colored, matching the hue of the rooster. The background is a plain, off-white or pale beige color, free of any additional objects or markings. The overall composition is centered, with the rooster occupying the middle of the image and the negative space being largely empty.
title: Weather Vane
